Major use cases include cross border payments from merchants (example, Amazon merchants in Asia get paid the same day) and remittances (tackling the $4T pre-funding problem) to large B2B trade finance

However, over reliance on automation risks overlooking credit nuances balanced human AI integration will be key for robust institutional adoption

policy.description:
Account funded by Fireblocks Custody dropped a $30k bet on NO US government shutdown by Saturday. Insider trading against the crowd?

Another $65k just sitting there, ready to double down.

Another $65k just sitting there, ready to double down. 

A few days ago, odds of a US gov shutdown by Saturday exploded from 9% to 80%.
Everything screams “shutdown is coming”… except for one loud NO.

Market: https://t.co/B9w7RDyFTu

Out of nowhere, a sus “insider” account nukes $30,000 on NO in this market.

Account: https://t.co/ttyAmPW553

If he’s right, he prints $137k off that $30k.

Plus there’s still $70k idle on Polymarket, ready to slam in.

Funding source? A wallet tagged Fireblocks Custody. Now it gets spicy.

Fireblocks works with banks, exchanges, VCs, hedge funds, ETF issuers, microfinance firms, payment processors, DeFi protocols - anyone who needs institutional-grade custody and compliance.

So I decided to join the fun.

I’m copying this “insider” and taking the NO side too - my experiment was getting too boring anyway (P&L flat for almost a month).

My account: https://t.co/v5xUQVpeLb

Thanks to @RDX_arXS for highlighting this account.

To strengthen how digital assets are protected on the platform, we h
company.description:
Security is an ongoing effort.

To strengthen how digital assets are protected on the platform, we have integrated Fireblocks, a globally trusted digital asset infrastructure provider that powers secure custody and wallet technology.

@FireblocksHQ is trusted by more than 2,400 institutions across the largest ecosystem of banks, payment providers, stablecoin issuers, exchanges, and custodians, and has secured the transfer of over $10 trillion in digital assets. 

By leveraging Fireblocks’ infrastructure, we are improving how assets are stored and protected with stronger controls around access and transaction approvals. 

This integration also supports faster and more secure operations as we expand blockchain support on the platform.

We will continue enhancing our security standards as we evolve 💪

Learn more about this integration 👉 https://t.co/scg02hLeht
